title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region-residency + audit hardening
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region-residency checks in RBAC v2 and harden audit logging. Adds migration to record kms_residency on resources; emits detailed audit events for KMS pin/violation decisions; rollout gated behind feature flag for 2 weeks before global enforcement.
description: Motivation: We need to ensure that RBAC v2 enforces KMS region residency (region pinning) consistently across hosted and private deployments and that the decision surface is fully auditable. This PR implements enforcement logic in the RBAC evaluation path, surfaces granular audit events for policy decisions (allowed/denied/soft-audit), and adds a migration to persist KMS residency metadata on existing resources. Summary of changes: 1) rbac-service: add kms_region constraint evaluation and short-circuit behavior when a resource is pinned to a region; 2) audit-logger: new event types (kms.residency.check, kms.residency.violation, kms.residency.allow) with structured metadata (actor, resource, requested_region, resource_region, policy_id, decision_reason); 3) db migration: add kms_region and kms_residency_verified columns to resources table + backfill script; 4) config: feature flag rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce with three modes (off, audit-only, enforce) and rollout helper scripts; 5) tests: unit + integration + e2e updates to cover positive/negative/residency-mismatch flows; 6) docs: security and admin docs with migration/rollback steps and rollout checklist. Rollout plan: start in audit-only for 72 hours in internal staging, enable audit-only on canary tenants for 48 hours, then gradually switch to enforce with monitoring and automatic rollback on regression. Backwards compatibility: default remains audit-only until we flip the global flag; the feature flag allows safe opt-in. Related: ENG-7123, SEC-204, SUP-8921.
